sprint_goal: Establish staging as the canonical pre-merge QA environment and close the CohortAnalysis architecture violation, backend integration test gap, and v1.7 QA scenario gaps that have been carried since v1.7–v1.9.

ST-01.title: Provision staging environment infrastructure
ST-01.notes: Staging live. API: https://trading-assistant-api-staging.onrender.com (health: healthy). Frontend: https://trading-assistant-staging.onrender.com (HTTP 200). Approach: Render Blueprint (Web Service + Static Site) + Supabase staging project. All AC verified. No deviations.

ST-02.title: Configure CI/CD auto-deploy to staging
ST-02.notes: Render Blueprint auto-deploy from main configured. AC satisfied: automated trigger on merge, no manual intervention, visible in Render dashboard, deploy time ~2-5 min. Implementation note: Render native auto-deploy used rather than a GitHub Actions workflow step — satisfies 'CI/CD dashboard or GitHub Actions output' AC text. No P0/P1 deviation.

ST-03.title: Update QA sign-off governance process
ST-03.notes: OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md updated to v3.19: §8.2 QA sign-off environment bullet added (staging URL https://trading-assistant-staging.onrender.com as canonical pre-merge QA environment, LL-01 resolution). §8.5 merge gate QA sign-off lines updated to reference staging URL explicitly. §14 table updated to v3.19. prompt_change_log.md row appended. Director of Quality confirmed updated process is workable. No deviations.

ST-04.title: Refactor CohortAnalysis.js to use backend endpoint
ST-04.notes: Reclassified autonomous on PO authority (no UX change — pure data-fetching swap). buildCohorts/getPeriodLabel/getPeriodKey removed. trades prop removed. useQuery + api.analytics.cohort(period) implemented. PerformanceAnalytics.js call-site updated. Deviation check: implementation matches analytics.md §15 and analytics_endpoints.md GET /analytics/cohort. DEV-EPIC02-ST03-01 (P2) resolved by this change. No new deviations.

ST-05.title: FastAPI TestClient integration tests for portfolio endpoints
ST-05.notes: tests/test_portfolio_integration.py created. Covers: GET /portfolio response shape, GBP conversion (UK+US positions), portfolio heat calculation, grace period/display_status. Deviation DEV-ST05-01 (P3): GET /portfolio/prospective-heat not in portfolio_endpoints.md and not implemented in backend — tests skipped with @unittest.skip. No P0/P1 deviations.

ST-06.title: Add integration test CI step
ST-06.notes: .github/workflows/integration-tests.yml created. Runs test_portfolio_integration on every PR and push to main/exec/**. Build fails if any test fails. Step named clearly. No deviations.
